title: Open and closed pieces of smooth proper schemes
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field] and let $Y$ be a scheme whose structure morphism $Y\to\operatorname{Spec}K$ is smooth and proper [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Let $Z$ be a nonempty scheme equipped with a morphism $i:Z\to Y$ that is both an open immersion and a closed immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Then the structure morphism $Z\to\operatorname{Spec}K$ is smooth and proper over $K$.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemmas 01VC (lemma-open-immersion-smooth) and 01VA (lemma-composition-smooth) for smoothness of the open immersion and its composite; 01W5 (lemma-closed-immersion-proper) and 01W3 (lemma-composition-proper) for properness of the closed immersion and its composite

proof.text: The morphism $i:Z\to Y$ is an open immersion by hypothesis. Applying [lem-pc-open-immersion-smooth-composition] to $i$ and the smooth structure morphism $Y\to\operatorname{Spec}K$ shows that the composite $Z\to\operatorname{Spec}K$ is smooth.

The morphism $i:Z\to Y$ is a closed immersion and the structure morphism $Y\to\operatorname{Spec}K$ is proper. Clause (b) of [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-proper] therefore gives that their composite $Z\to\operatorname{Spec}K$ is proper.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemmas 01W5 (closed immersions are proper) and 01W3 (composition of proper morphisms)
